artifacts.name: Hot-spots & cold-spots
artifacts.summary: Global Moran’s I = -0.03. 0 hot-spot and 0 cold-spot neighbourhood(s) of cool locations density (local Moran’s I / LISA). Only 10 sub-areas: too few for the permutation test to establish significance, so read a grey map as "not enough units to tell", not as "no clustering". Use a finer `subarea_mode` or a larger area to make this map informative. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
Sub-areas classified by the local Moran’s I statistic (LISA) over cool locations density: **High-High** = a dense neighbourhood surrounded by others like it (hot-spot); **Low-Low** = a sparse one among others like it (cold-spot); **High-Low / Low-High** = spatial outliers. Significance uses a deterministic permutation test; non-significant sub-areas are greyed out.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: cool_locations · reachability: straight-line distance.

artifacts.name: Heat-refuge suitability
artifacts.summary: A combined layer (weighted sum) of 2×Parks & green spaces, 1.5×Public swimming & bathing, 1×Places of worship, 1×Shopping centres, per sub-area. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
Map algebra: for each administrative sub-area, the normalised densities of the input categories are combined by **weighted sum** — 2×Parks & green spaces, 1.5×Public swimming & bathing, 1×Places of worship, 1×Shopping centres — into a single value. Each category is first rescaled to 0–1 across sub-areas, so the value is a unitless index. Use it to express a composite index (e.g. a weighted suitability score) as one layer instead of several.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: cool_locations · reachability: straight-line distance.

artifacts.name: Provision per capita

artifacts.name: Distance to nearest cool location
artifacts.summary: How far to the nearest cool location from anywhere in the area (metres). Darker = further. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
A regular grid over the area, each cell shaded by the straight-line distance to the nearest cool location. Dark cells are the furthest from any feature — the access gaps. Straight-line (not routed), so it is an optimistic lower bound; it needs no routing service.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: cool_locations · reachability: straight-line distance.

artifacts.name: Data currentness
artifacts.summary: How recently each cool location was last edited in OpenStreetMap (median 1 yr ago). Darker = longer since the last edit. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
Each point is a feature, shaded by the number of years since its last OpenStreetMap edit (measured against the data snapshot). Clusters of dark points mark areas where the OSM picture is ageing and may warrant a re-survey — a spatial companion to the data-quality note.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: cool_locations · reachability: straight-line distance.

artifacts.name: Availability on a Sunday afternoon
artifacts.summary: Opening hours are recorded for 71% of managed venues. 26 cool locations are known to be open on a Sunday afternoon. "Not specified" mostly covers freely accessible open-air places carrying no opening hours.
artifacts.description:
Features classified by whether their OpenStreetMap opening_hours indicate they are open at a fixed reference time (a Sunday afternoon). Managed venues such as libraries and museums may be closed then; open-air places usually carry no opening hours and are counted as "not specified". This indicator is only shown where enough venues carry opening hours to be meaningful.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: cool_locations · reachability: straight-line distance.

artifacts.description:
Features classified by whether their OpenStreetMap opening_hours indicate they are open at a fixed reference time (a Sunday afternoon). Managed venues such as libraries and museums may be closed then; open-air places usually carry no opening hours and are counted as "not specified". This indicator is only shown where enough venues carry opening hours to be meaningful.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: cool_locations · reachability: straight-line distance.
